No in-window (2–5 Nov 2026) social or video content about East Bengaluru property was found. I ran 10 searches and fetched 6 pages.

Platform access:
- Reddit: WebFetch refused reddit.com. I only saw news write-ups and third-party mirrors of older threads, none dated in the window.
- YouTube: the results page returned only footer text. Search surfaced no YouTube videos.
- LinkedIn: logged-out access returned HTTP 403, so public posts could not be read.

Everything the searches did surface was developer, broker or portal blog content (Sobha, Brigade, NBR, Housing.com) or news write-ups of Reddit threads dated April 2026 or earlier. All of it is interested-party or anecdotal and none supports a material claim in the window. The latest metro status I saw was an August 2026 report, so I could not confirm whether the October Blue Line trials took place. That is a gap, not a finding.
